prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / product-mockup. Create a premium photorealistic full-body fashion lookbook photograph of the SAME adult man FRANCO from reference 1, wearing the exact SIERRA documentary t-shirt in reference 2, in a distinctly OVERSIZED streetwear cut. Reference 1 is the canonical character sheet and identity source: preserve his precise facial anatomy, age, medium olive skin, brown eyes, prominent nose, long dark brown shoulder-length hair, slightly graying full short beard, earrings, necklace, visible existing tattoos, wristwatch and bracelet. Do not beautify, de-age, masculinize, slim or replace him with a generic model. Reference 2 defines the garment color and exact original graphics, small left-heart chest print and large original back print. Reference 3 is the original back artwork for fidelity. No original navy shirt, no original 'ART ATELIER / ORIGINAL DENIM' text. The t-shirt is fashionably very oversize: boxy wide body, pronounced dropped shoulders, broad sleeves down to near the elbows, thick 240gsm matte cotton, convincing soft weight and folds, generous torso volume, hem ending below hips around upper thigh. It should look intentional and stylish, not fitted, and retain Franco's real body proportions under the fabric. Wear with his loose light-wash straight/baggy denim jeans, offwhite sneakers with subtle gray and muted green details as in the sheet, understated accessories. Plain warm light stone-gray seamless photographic studio background and matching matte floor, soft directional daylight, understated editorial fashion mood, highly realistic skin/cloth/hair without plastic smoothing. One man only, full body head-to-toe including both shoes, enough margin above hair and below feet, portrait 2:3 high resolution. Preserve original SIERRA ink print, shapes and typography, no reinterpretation of artwork or faces in the drawing. Chest print ONLY is tiny original illustration over wearer's LEFT heart (roughly7cm wide), NO chest wordmark. Back print ONLY is original large illustration with original SIERRA lettering and EXACT 'UN DOCUMENTAL DE JUAN F. MONTES' underneath, approximately28cm wide. Never swap front/back prints, no floating graphic, no text labels, watermarks or new logos. Detailed quality suitable for inspecting shirt fit and styling.
BLACK t-shirt with light stone-white ink. Pose: show his BACK in a gentle three-quarter turn, back plane almost parallel to camera so the entire Reyes-and-baby-goats artwork and signature can be inspected; face turns over his LEFT shoulder enough for recognizable profile, right hand casually in front jeans pocket, left arm relaxed to side, legs comfortably apart with one knee flexed. His shoulder-length hair naturally stops at the neck/shoulder line; print begins below hair and remains visible. Main emphasis the full back print and roomy elbow-length sleeves. Keep all back artwork including signature unoccluded.
